meta.code: ui.panel.dashboardTitle
ui.panel.desc_ai_analyzer
en: AI manuscript analysis - pacing, character arcs, repeated words, conflict and scene length (mockup for now).

meta.code: ui.panel.desc_books
en: Manage books and drafts - cover, blurb, status, per-book statistics, drag to reorder.

meta.code: ui.panel.desc_branch
en: The branching story map — scene cards joined by choice links · drag cards around · pick card/line colours · warns about dead ends, loops and choices with no target · exports to HTML/Markdown/JSON/image

meta.code: ui.panel.desc_comments
en: Comments on the open scene - threaded replies, resolvable. Stored at the end of the .md file so they travel with it.

meta.code: ui.panel.desc_dashboard
en: Progress at a glance - word count against your goal, scene status breakdown, and chapter lengths.

meta.code: ui.panel.desc_docs
en: The main writing area - every open tab: scenes, screenplays and Wiki pages (cannot be closed).

meta.code: ui.panel.desc_gallery
en: Every image in the project Images folder - drag one into a document to insert it, or pick it as a cover or Wiki portrait.

meta.code: ui.panel.desc_kanban
en: Scenes as cards grouped by status - drag a card to another column to change that scene status.

meta.code: ui.panel.desc_log
en: The application log - use it when something does not behave the way you expect.

meta.code: ui.panel.desc_maps
en: Maps of your story world - drop pins on an image and link them to scenes or locations. Portal pins lead to sub-maps.

meta.code: ui.panel.desc_notes
en: A scratch pad for thoughts that should not go into the manuscript - notes attach to the scene open at the time.

meta.code: ui.panel.desc_outline
en: Heading outline of the file you have open - click a heading to jump there.

meta.code: ui.panel.desc_player
en: Read the story as a player would — the scene text is read-only, then click a choice button to walk on · step back any time · every run is kept so you can review the path

meta.code: ui.panel.desc_props
en: Properties of the selected scene - synopsis, POV, emotion, conflict, status, color, tags. Saves automatically as you type.

meta.code: ui.panel.desc_search
en: Full-text search across the project - every scene, book and Wiki page. Click a result to open the file at that line.

meta.code: ui.panel.desc_statusbar
en: A summary of the open document - word/page count, screenplay errors, and the page zoom slider.

meta.code: ui.panel.desc_timeline
en: Events ordered by in-story time - switch between card and Gantt views. Scenes with a storyDate appear automatically.

meta.code: ui.panel.desc_toolbar
en: All formatting buttons and mode switches - bold/italic, alignment, reading/focus mode, show/hide other panels.

meta.code: ui.panel.desc_tree
en: The table of contents of the whole work - book, chapter, scene, plus Wiki, gallery and trash. Drag to reorder. The search box filters by title, tag and status.
